name: Calcutta Paan Mouth Freshener – 180gm
original_description:
Calcutta Paan Mouth Freshener is a delightful post-meal treat and breath freshener meticulously crafted from betel leaves, areca nut, and an assortment of spices and flavorings. This offering bears a resemblance to traditional paan but is finely ground, intended for chewing rather than swallowing whole. Paan mukhwas is perfect for aiding digestion and revitalizing the breath after a meal. What distinguishes Calcutta paan mukhwas is its renowned high quality and unique flavor, attributed to the distinctive growing conditions in the region where it is cultivated.

Benefits of Calcutta Paan Mouth Freshener:

  • Ideal for promoting digestion and revitalizing your breath after a meal.
  • Renowned for its exceptional quality and distinctive flavor, derived from the distinct growing conditions of the cultivation region.
  • A singular post-meal treat and breath freshener, thoughtfully composed of betel leaf, areca nut, and an array of spices and flavorings.
  • Echoing the essence of traditional paan, it is finely ground for a chewable experience, not meant for swallowing.

Ingredients

  • Dry dates
  • Rose petal jam
  • Areca nut powder
  • Fennel seeds
  • Paan leaf
  • Licorice
